rationale: The FAA's 'Roadmap for Artificial Intelligence Safety Assurance, Version I' (PDF p. 14) explicitly states that for learned AI implementations, 'those links are broken; the designer cannot derive the requirements that directly describe the AI implementation and cannot validate them by showing that they provide coverage to the next higher level.' This directly supports the claim that the FAA describes learned implementation as a break from conventional lower-level requirement traceability for the learned algorithm itself.
evidence_locators: PDF p. 14, application of principles to aircraft certification safety assurance of learned AI implementations
